title: Hild's Chalk Board
text:
Chalked on a slate hung from a lavender stake, in a big round hand:

ROWS 1-9 SMOKED. ROWS 10-14 DO NOT GO. The east hives are angry.

If you are a beekeeper still, come to the press house. There is bread. If you are the Synod, the bees are waiting for you, and so am I.

H.
